messages:
Sam (Product): Dropped a compact playground mock. Focus: streaming display, a tiny token counter, and an inline prompt-library preview that shows +N tokens before insert. Fig: https://redwood-internal.mock/s/pg-mini. Quick takes? Iris (Design): Prefer label 'Pause' over 'Stop' (users expect resume). Token counter should be a condensed pill (120/2k) that expands on hover with cost. Preview hover shows '+15 tokens' and small preview of the snippet. Dev (Eng): Note on impl: server-side resume mid-stream isn't available. We'll do client pause: abort stream, keep buffer, resume by sending buffered text as prefix. Need overlap dedupe (suffix-prefix compare) and a resumed flag in telemetry. Noor (A11y): SR note: don't put aria-live on whole message. Use a summary live region like: ```html
Streaming: 2 chunks
``` Make token pill keyboard-focusable with aria-valuetext 'Tokens: 120 of 2048'. Contrast needs to meet 4.5:1. Lee (DevEx): Microcopy: token tooltip -> 'Tokens · used 120 / cap 2048 · est $0.02'. Prompt insert modal -> 'Insert will add +15 tokens (est $0.003). Insert?'. Analytics: add prompt_insert_token_delta and generation_resumed. Sam (Product): Decided: primary = 'Pause', secondary = 'Stop & keep' in overflow. Action: Iris update mock with hover preview + contrast; Dev spike client pause POC; Noor add SR QA checks; Lee wire tooltip + analytics. Short sync Wed. Thanks! :thumbsup:
